# Advanced Patterns

issues.should_add: Complete chapter content covering multiline search, PCRE2 engine features, lookahead/lookbehind assertions, Unicode patterns, and advanced regex techniques with working examples
issues.fix_suggestion: Populate the entire chapter with advanced regex pattern documentation based on ripgrep's actual capabilities

issues.description: No documentation of multiline search mode which allows matching across line boundaries
issues.should_add: Comprehensive multiline search documentation: -U/--multiline flag, how it enables matching \n in patterns, use of \p{any} for any character including newlines, memory implications, performance considerations
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section explaining multiline mode: Basic usage with -U flag, explain that by default matches cannot span lines, show examples like 'rg -U "abc\ndef"' matching across lines, explain \p{any} vs . behavior, warn about memory usage (must read entire file into memory), note automatic optimization when pattern doesn't need it. Include practical examples from tests/multiline.rs

issues.description: No documentation of --multiline-dotall flag which makes . match newlines
issues.should_add: Documentation of --multiline-dotall flag and its interaction with multiline mode
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section on dotall mode: Explain default behavior where . doesn't match \n even in multiline mode, show --multiline-dotall flag makes . match newlines, explain alternative inline syntax (?s:.) for enabling dotall in pattern, provide examples contrasting 'rg -U "world.+detective"' (fails) vs 'rg -U --multiline-dotall "world.+detective"' (succeeds), mention \p{any} as alternative that always matches newlines
issues.source_reference: crates/core/flags/defs.rs:4214-4272 (MultilineDotall flag), tests/multiline.rs:20-43 (dot_no_newline and dot_all tests)

issues.description: No documentation of PCRE2 regex engine support and how to enable it
issues.should_add: PCRE2 engine documentation: -P/--pcre2 flag, --engine option, when to use PCRE2 vs default engine, feature differences, availability, performance considerations
issues.fix_suggestion: Add comprehensive PCRE2 section: Explain -P/--pcre2 flag enables PCRE2 engine, mention --engine=pcre2|default|auto options, explain 'auto' mode dynamically chooses engine based on pattern features, note PCRE2 is optional compile-time feature (check with --pcre2-version), list key differences (PCRE2 supports lookaround and backreferences, default engine is faster for most cases), warn about less helpful error messages with PCRE2, provide examples showing when PCRE2 is needed

issues.description: No documentation of lookahead/lookbehind assertions which are PCRE2-only features
issues.should_add: Complete lookaround assertions documentation with syntax and examples
issues.fix_suggestion: Add detailed lookaround section: Explain these are PCRE2-only features (require -P flag), cover positive lookahead (?=...), negative lookahead (?!...), positive lookbehind (?<=...), negative lookbehind (?<!...). Provide practical examples: 'rg -P ".*o(?!.*\s)"' (find lines ending with 'o' before last word), 'rg -UP "(?<=foo\n)bar"' (match 'bar' preceded by 'foo\n'), explain use cases like filtering based on context without including it in match, show combination with -o/--only-matching for precise extraction
issues.source_reference: tests/regression.rs:1040-1075 (lookahead/lookbehind tests), tests/regression.rs:1145-1167 (multiline lookahead), crates/core/flags/defs.rs:5358-5359 (mentions lookaround)

issues.description: No documentation of backreferences which are PCRE2-only features
issues.should_add: Backreferences documentation explaining syntax and use cases
issues.fix_suggestion: Add backreferences section: Explain PCRE2-only feature requiring -P flag, show syntax for numbered backreferences (\1, \2, etc.) and named backreferences, provide examples like 'rg -P "(\w+)\s+\1"' to find repeated words, explain use with replacements -r flag for complex transformations, note performance implications (backreferences prevent some optimizations)

issues.description: No documentation of Unicode character classes and properties available in regex patterns
issues.should_add: Unicode character classes documentation: \p{...} syntax, common properties, Unicode-aware \w\s\d, case folding, word boundaries
issues.fix_suggestion: Add Unicode section: Explain Unicode mode is default in ripgrep, show \p{Property} syntax for Unicode character classes, list common properties (\p{Emoji}, \p{Greek}, \p{Alphabetic}, \p{Uppercase}), explain \p{any} matches any Unicode codepoint including newlines, document Unicode-aware \w (all Unicode word characters not just ASCII), \s (Unicode whitespace), Unicode case folding with -i flag, Unicode word boundaries \b, show examples 'rg "\p{Emoji}"', 'rg "\p{Greek}+"', mention --no-unicode flag to disable for ASCII-only performance

issues.description: No documentation of --engine flag and auto engine selection
issues.should_add: Documentation of --engine flag with default/pcre2/auto options and selection heuristics
issues.fix_suggestion: Add engine selection section: Document --engine flag accepts 'default', 'pcre2', or 'auto', explain 'default' uses Rust regex (finite automata, fastest, good for most cases), 'pcre2' uses PCRE2 (supports advanced features, may be slower), 'auto' dynamically chooses based on pattern analysis (uses PCRE2 if pattern requires lookaround/backreferences, default otherwise), note --auto-hybrid-regex is deprecated in favor of --engine=auto, explain tradeoffs (auto mode can have surprising performance changes, explicit choice more predictable)

issues.description: No documentation of named capture groups syntax and use with replacements
issues.should_add: Named capture groups documentation with syntax and replacement examples
issues.fix_suggestion: Add named captures section: Show syntax (?P<name>...) for defining named groups (both engines support), explain use with -r flag for replacements using $name or ${name}, provide examples like 'rg "(?P<func>\w+)\(" -r "Function: $func"', contrast with numbered captures $1, $2, show practical use cases for complex replacements maintaining readability

issues.description: No documentation of inline regex flags like (?s), (?i), (?m)
issues.should_add: Documentation of inline regex flags for controlling regex behavior within patterns
issues.fix_suggestion: Add inline flags section: Document (?s) for dotall (. matches \n), (?i) for case-insensitive, (?m) for multi-line anchors, (?x) for verbose mode with comments, show syntax (?flags:pattern) for scoped application vs (?flags) for rest of pattern, provide examples 'rg "(?s:.)"' vs 'rg "(?s)."', explain precedence over command-line flags, note (?-s) to disable flags

issues.description: No documentation of performance and memory considerations for advanced patterns
issues.should_add: Performance guidance for multiline, PCRE2, and complex patterns
issues.fix_suggestion: Add performance section: Warn multiline mode requires reading entire file into memory (can't use memory mapping for stdin), explain PCRE2 generally slower than default engine especially for simple patterns, note backreferences and lookaround prevent some optimizations, recommend testing performance with --stats flag, suggest using default engine when possible, explain automatic optimization (ripgrep detects when multiline pattern doesn't actually match \n and avoids memory penalty)

issues.description: No documentation of pattern limitations and common mistakes with advanced features
issues.should_add: Common pitfalls and limitations when using advanced regex features
issues.fix_suggestion: Add gotchas section: Explain PCRE2 silently fails instead of error when using \n without --multiline (unlike default engine), note lookaround/backreferences not available in default engine, warn about forgetting -P flag when using PCRE2 features, explain . doesn't match newlines by default even in multiline mode (need --multiline-dotall or (?s)), document that --no-unicode affects all patterns globally, mention regex size limits (--regex-size-limit)

issues.description: No working examples demonstrating advanced pattern techniques
issues.should_add: Real-world examples showing advanced patterns solving actual problems
issues.fix_suggestion: Add comprehensive examples section: Multi-line log parsing 'rg -U "ERROR.*\n.*stack trace"', finding functions with specific usage patterns using lookahead 'rg -UP "(?s)def (\w+);(?=.*use \w+)"', extracting specific parts with lookaround and -o, finding repeated words 'rg -P "(\w+)\s+\1"', searching specific Unicode scripts 'rg "\p{Han}+"', complex replacements with named captures, combining multiline with PCRE2 for powerful queries. Each example should include explanation of why advanced features are needed

issues.description: No mention of --pcre2-version flag to check PCRE2 availability
issues.should_add: Documentation of --pcre2-version flag for checking PCRE2 support
issues.fix_suggestion: Add note about checking PCRE2 availability: Mention --pcre2-version flag shows PCRE2 version and JIT status if available, exits with error if PCRE2 not compiled in, useful for checking if advanced features are available before using them

issues.should_add: Documentation of regex complexity limits and how to adjust them
issues.fix_suggestion: Add limits section: Explain --regex-size-limit controls compiled regex size (default sufficient for most cases), --dfa-size-limit controls DFA size for default engine, note these prevent excessive memory use for extremely complex patterns, show how to increase if hitting limits, mention error messages will suggest increasing limits when needed
issues.source_reference: features.json:search_engine (DFA size limits, regex size limits)
